name: auto-progress
description: Guarded Unity C# improvement discovery, rejection policy, and batch maintenance with human-reviewed pull requests.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, reject, and batch Unity C# improvements safely.
interface.longDescription: Discover review-ready Unity C# candidates in bounded manual sessions, manage human rejection policy, and implement compatible batches while reserving daily limits for scheduled work and preserving human merge control.
defaultPrompt: Configure AutoProgress for this Unity repository.
